_comment: How each car looks in the Unreal client (Source/SimCruise/*/Presentation). Physics stays in data/cars/<id>.json. Boxes and points use the Unreal vehicle frame: X forward, Y right, Z up, metres, origin midway between the axles at the physics body origin. Colours are "#rrggbb" sRGB. Roles: see SimCruiseCarMaterialRoles.h. Every value that copies a real car names its source.

nb2001.credit: "Mazda MX-5 (NB) convertible HQ interior" by Nieve5677 (https://sketchfab.com/niev), CC BY 4.0
nb2001.steering_ratio_source: 15:1 overall, power rack, 2.6 turns lock to lock (GoAuto, 2001 MX-5 review; the NB power rack is the same 1999-2005).

paint.name: Emerald Mica (DU)
paint.source: 1999 NB Emerald Mica, a mica green; matched by eye to the green 1999 cars in the taste references (Kevauto front/rear 4.28.18, DestinationFearFan 1999 Mazda MX-5 Miata), which read lighter and less blue than the Godot build's #0f3b2a.

badges.note: MX-5 lettering on the tail panel, left of the plate
mazda wordmark on the tail panel, right of the plate

clock.source: display_baseColor.png paints 5:12 between x 650-990 and y 15-112 of 1024 x 128; the dash shows it upside down (seven-segment 5 reads as 2), as 2:15. The NB clock is a 12-hour green LCD.

nb2001.roles_source: 'white' is the cluster's numerals and ticks and the console's labels (meshes only on the dash, x -9..47, y -83..-49 cm in the model): backlit like the real panel, 25 nits, which daylight in the cabin drowns and night shows.

paint.name: Atlas paint (author texture)

paint.name: Torch Red (GKZ)
paint.source: C8 Torch Red, a solid red; the model's Body_Color factor (0.539, 0.015, 0.010 linear) is the same hue.
